key_insight: The paper presents an LLM-assisted pipeline that automatically builds and incrementally updates a knowledge graph of ML interatomic potential (MLIP) models from scientific documents.
engineering_relevance: This enables more consistent tracking, querying, and comparison of rapidly evolving materials ML models, supporting faster discovery and better reuse of MLIP knowledge.
method: Extract model information from papers and articles using an LLM-based information extraction workflow.
Validate and correct extracted triples with SHACL constraints in a loop to improve consistency.
Build the knowledge graph model-by-model so new MLIP models can be added iteratively.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a knowledge graph built from models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard and demonstrates that it supports queries about interesting aspects of those models.
watch_item: Automatic extraction and validation still depend on the quality of source documents and constraint design, so edge cases and missing or inconsistent metadata may require human oversight.
paper_title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
